arxiv-1909-08308.title: An Empirical Study on Arrival Rates of Limit Orders and Order Cancellation Rates in Borsa Istanbul Journal: Borsa Istanbul Review
arxiv-1909-08308.creator: Can Yilmaz Altinigne, Harun Ozkan, Veli Can Kupeli, Zehra Cataltepe
arxiv-1909-08308.description: Abstract Order book dynamics play an important role in both execution time and price formation of orders in an exchange market. In this study, we aim to model the limit order arrival rates in the vicinity of the best bid and the best ask price levels.

arxiv-2107-10423.title: Scalable Molecular GW Calculations: Valence and Core Spectra
arxiv-2107-10423.creator: Daniel Mejia-Rodriguez, Alexander Kunitsa, Edoardo Aprà, Niranjan Govind
arxiv-2107-10423.description: Abstract We present a scalable implementation of the G ​ W GW approximation using Gaussian atomic orbitals to study the valence and core ionization spectroscopies of molecules. The implementation of the standard spectral decomposition approach to the screened Coulomb interaction, as well as a contour deformation method are described.

arxiv-2311-12282.title: Orthogonally weighted ℓ 2 , 1 \ell_{2,1} regularization for rank-aware joint sparse recovery: algorithm and analysis Thanks: Armenak Petrosyan’s research was partially funded by a Georgia Tech-ORNL SEED grant. Armenak Petrosyan also thanks Christopher Heil for continued support during his employment
arxiv-2311-12282.creator: Armenak Petrosyan, Konstantin Pieper, Hoang Tran
arxiv-2311-12282.description: Abstract . We propose and analyze an efficient algorithm for solving the joint sparse recovery problem using a new regularization-based method, named orthogonally weighted ℓ 2 , 1 \ell_{2,1} ( 𝑜𝑤 ​ ℓ 2 , 1 \mathit{ow}\ell_{2,1} ), which is specifically designed to take into account the rank of the solution matrix.

arxiv-2403-01631.title: TreeTracker Join: Simple, Optimal, Fast
arxiv-2403-01631.creator: Zeyuan Hu, Remy Wang, Daniel P. Miranker
arxiv-2403-01631.description: Abstract . We present a novel linear-time acyclic join algorithm, TreeTracker Join ( TTJ ). The algorithm can be understood as the pipelined binary hash join with a simple twist: upon a hash lookup failure, TTJ resets execution to the binding of the tuple causing the failure, and removes the offending tuple from its relation.

arxiv-2503-20077.title: Enhancing wave-particle duality
arxiv-2503-20077.creator: Arwa Bukhari, Daniel Hodgson, Sara Kanzi, Robert Purdy, Almut Beige
arxiv-2503-20077.description: Abstract To enhance the consistency between the quantum descriptions of waves and particles, we quantise mechanical point particles in this paper in the same physically-motivated way as we previously quantised light in quantum electrodynamics [Bennett et al. , Eur. J. Phys. 37 , 014001 (2016)].

arxiv-2508-18419.title: Reduction of Feynman Integrals in the Parametric Representation IV: Integrals with Irregular Integration Regions
arxiv-2508-18419.creator: Wen Chen
arxiv-2508-18419.description: Abstract Parametric Feynman integrals with the regions of integration defined by some polynomials are considered in this paper. It is shown that integrals with irregular integration regions can be converted to standard parametric integrals, for which a reduction method is known. An application of this method to the analytic calculation of three-point energy correlators is presented.

arxiv-2510-23379.title: Symbolic Neural Generation with Applications to Lead Discovery in Drug Design
arxiv-2510-23379.creator: Ashwin Srinivasan ashwin@goa.bits-pilani.ac.in, A. Baskar abaskar@goa.bits-pilani.ac.in, Tirtharaj Dash td522@cam.ac.uk, Michael Bain m.bain@unsw.edu.au, Sanjay Kumar Dey skdey@acbr.du.ac.in, Mainak Banerjee mainak@goa.bits-pilani.ac.in
arxiv-2510-23379.description: Abstract We investigate a relatively under-explored class of hybrid neurosymbolic models that integrate symbolic learning with neural reasoning to construct data generators meeting formal correctness criteria. In Symbolic Neural Generators (SNGs), symbolic learners examine logical specifications of feasible data from a small set of instances—sometimes just one.

pmc-11402319.title: Effectiveness of cyclic treatment of municipal wastewater by Tetradesmus obliquus – Loofah biofilm, its internal community changes and potential for resource utilization
pmc-11402319.creator: Zhongqi He, Xu Zhou, Nannan Mei, Wenbiao Jin, Jing Sun, Shiyu Yin, Qilin Wang
pmc-11402319.description: Highlights•Tetradesmus obliquus-loofah biofilm treats 7 batches of wastewater in one month.•Biofilm removes more than 80 % of nitrogen and almost 100 % of phosphorus in each batch.•In late stage, biofilm is more suitable for extracting proteins and polysaccharides.•Rotifers present lead to a decrease in the effectiveness of wastewater treatment.•Aerobic and facultative bacteria contribute to algae-bacteria system formation.

The prevalence of right ventricular involvement in acute myocarditis is suggested to be more frequent than previously hypothesized.

pmc-11738724.title: Antipsychotic Prescribing for In-Patients With Dementia at University Hospital Llandough to Look for Good Prescribing Practice in Line With NICE Guidelines
pmc-11738724.creator: Rakesh Puli, Arpita Chakrabarti
pmc-11738724.description: AimsNICE guidelines stipulate that alternative causative factors for Behavioural and Psychiatric Symptoms of Dementia (BPSD) must be considered before starting antipsychotic treatment. The symptoms of BPSD include agitation, aggression, wandering, hoarding, sexual disinhibition, shouting, repeated questioning, sleep disturbance, depression, anxiety and psychosis.

pmc-12416195.description: Host – microbiome interactions are central to Crohn’sdisease (CD) pathogenesis; yet the early metabolic alterations that precededisease onset remain poorly defined. To explore preclinical metabolicsignatures of CD, we analyzed baseline serum metabolomic profiles in a nestedcase-control study within the Crohn’s and Colitis Canada – Genetics, Environment, Microbiome (CCC-GEM) Project, a prospective cohort of 5,122 healthyfirst-degree relatives (FDRs) of CD patients.
